description: R-SQL-1 SQL-EQ-01, SQL-KEY-02, SQL-KEY-03, SQL-REL: Which S rows (Null, empty, trailing and leading space, case and accent variants, embedded U+0000, long common prefixes, ligature, exact duplicate) collapse together, and which representative value is returned, under DISTINCT on Text, GROUP BY on Text with Count, DISTINCT on a Text expression (t & ''), DISTINCT and GROUP BY on Memo, and a self-join on Text equality?
